    sys.setrecursionlimit(1 << 25)
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    k = int(data[2])
    f = list(map(int, data[3:3 + n]))
    p = list(map(int, data[3 + n:3 + n + m]))
    dp = [0] * n
    for i in range(n):
        dp[i] = mod_inverse(n)
    for _ in range(k):
        ndp = [0] * n
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(m):
                ndp[f[i] - 1] = (ndp[f[i] - 1] + dp[i] * p[j]) % MOD
        dp = ndp
    for prob in dp:
        print(prob)
